purpose: Separately fitted DEBM (engines original and repaired, fitted in one job from the same mixture fit) with the pyebm 2.0.3 default stopping rule. Different composition (REF_H0) and same composition (IID_H0); a new random true sequence for each dataset, shared by the three groups; measurements missing completely at random. Unrestricted and within-diagnosis permutation with 599 relabelings; a comparison is rejected when P = (1 + E)/600 <= 0.05/3. Computation stops once no further relabeling can change the three decisions, except in the first 100 datasets, which use all 599. Used in Fig. 2b and Fig. 3a (REF_H0, repaired).
